notes:
Lead source: PLG self-serve (Indie dev). Founder / sole dev (Ben Torres). Quick notes from signup and early tests:
- Very small team: 1 full-time dev, 1 contractor. Building a micro-SaaS 'contextual onboarding' widget for SaaS products.
- Primary flow: user enters product docs -> generate embeddings -> semantic search + chat overlay.
- Preferences: hosted API only (no VPC), public cloud OK. Wants simple pricing estimate before committing to paid tier.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Quote: "I need to know how much it costs to run 50k token queries a month — can't guess."
- Model preference: prefers small quantized open models (7B/13B) to keep costs down; interested in recommended fallback variants for cheaper throughput.
- Performance targets: median chatbot response <500ms preferred; embeddings bulk job can be asynchronous. Expect 2-5 QPS for chat, batch embeddings nightly.
- Security: not enterprise-grade yet; wants audit logging + retention controls, may consider SOC2 if revenue justifies.
- Integration notes: using Node + Next.js, requests via REST. Hit token-limit errors during long context tests; might benefit from prefix caching and dynamic truncation.
- Quote from founder on call: "Works great locally, but I need a predictable monthly bill before I recommend to beta customers."
- Interested in: quickstart prompts, batching/caching recommendations, example cost calc for 50k vs 200k tokens/mo.
- Tone: pragmatic, low-touch, looking for clear docs and community help.
- Action items: send tailored cost calc + sample next.js code snippet; add to PLG nurture drip; invite to community Slack and sandbox AMAs.
